column1: # Fixed swaps an NPC makes in conversation: exactly one item out and one item in, at these amounts.
# While a dialogue is on screen, such a change books as a counted "Exchanged" trade instead of Review;
# what went out keeps the value it was booked at, so the row counts the difference.
# item id and quantity out (negative) <TAB> item id and quantity in <TAB> name
# Minimus (Fortis Colosseum) takes a spare Dizana's quiver (uncharged) for 4,000 sunfire splinters
